title: Refund
description: Refund transaction record for returning money to a customer. Tracks refund amount, reason, status, processing date, and associated order.

id.description: Unique identifier for the refund record

order_id.description: Foreign key reference to the order this refund is associated with

amount.description: Refund amount to be returned to the customer

currency.description: ISO currency code for the refund amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP)

reason.description: Reason for the refund (e.g., defective product, wrong item, customer request)

status.description: Current refund status (e.g., pending, processing, completed, cancelled)

processed_date.description: Timestamp when the refund was processed and funds were returned
